<a name="GitHubEvent"></a>
## type GitHubEvent

GitHubEvent

User\-facing record of a Git provider event observed by the platform. Immutable once accepted — the controller writes status, never the spec. GitHubPayload is the platform\-generated counterpart \(auto, ephemeral, auditable\); GitHubEvent is the user\-facing surface. Pipeline chain:

```
GitRepository → GitHubEvent → Build → SupplyChain → Package → Deployment
```

Resource

```go
type GitHubEvent struct {

    // Standard BlanketOps metadata (name, namespace, labels, ownerRef).
    Metadata *v1.Metadata `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=metadata,proto3" json:"metadata,omitempty"`
    // The observed event. Immutable once accepted.
    Spec *GitHubEventSpec `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=spec,proto3" json:"spec,omitempty"`
    // Observed state set by the controller. Never manually edited.
    Status *GitHubEventStatus `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=status,proto3" json:"status,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

## type GitHubEventServiceClient

GitHubEventServiceClient is the client API for GitHubEventService service.

For semantics around ctx use and closing/ending streaming RPCs, please refer to https://pkg.go.dev/google.golang.org/grpc/?tab=doc#ClientConn.NewStream.

Service

```go
type GitHubEventServiceClient interface {
    // ── CRD surface — events are immutable, no Update/Patch ─────────────────
    // Record a new event. Primary path for MANUAL dispatch.
    CreateGitHubEvent(ctx context.Context, in *CreateGitHubEventRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*CreateGitHubEventResponse, error)
    // Fetch a GitHubEvent CR by name.
    GetGitHubEvent(ctx context.Context, in *GetGitHubEventRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*GetGitHubEventResponse, error)
    // List GitHubEvent CRs with optional repository/type/triggered filter and paging.
    ListGitHubEvents(ctx context.Context, in *ListGitHubEventsRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*ListGitHubEventsResponse, error)
    // Delete a GitHubEvent CR. Normally handled by TTL garbage collection.
    DeleteGitHubEvent(ctx context.Context, in *DeleteGitHubEventRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*DeleteGitHubEventResponse, error)
    // ── Streaming ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Stream state transitions for GitHubEvent CRs by name or label selector.
    WatchGitHubEvent(ctx context.Context, in *WatchGitHubEventRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (grpc.ServerStreamingClient[WatchGitHubEventResponse], error)
}
```
